# SwiftASN1 local dependency

Unmodified sources from Apple swift-asn1 1.7.3, commit 3b6410f7dee09eb33cdd26260c5fd47fda19b0e2. Narrow local manifest omits upstream tests/docs/CMake and uses the public SwiftASN1 product. No network resolution at build time. Source hashes/archive hash in manifest.json; Apache-2.0 license included.
